verdict.rationale: Paxos documents transfer status polling, webhook event lifecycles with retry windows, and monthly reserve/attestation reports for stablecoins, giving partial visibility into settlement flows, but there is no published fee schedule per rail, no documented payment-to-available-balance timing SLAs, and no accounting-consumable statements/reports beyond stablecoin reserve attestations. Missing for 10: published per-rail fee schedules, explicit settlement timing/SLA documentation, and downloadable accounting statements or ledger reports.
